principalConclusion: ARA should preserve AraLearn as its first functional reference profile while using broad but bounded external research to discover configurations and capabilities absent from the predecessor. The recommended product direction is a small recognizable educational core, explicit configuration and research layers, and governed extensibility separated into representations, practices, instruments and optional capabilities.

recommendedPath.summary: Maintain an AraLearn-recognizable course and study experience; discover parameters from multiple source classes; normalize only recommended and accepted dimensions; let #6 define product concepts and #7 select architecture through ADRs.

alternatives.reason: It would preserve simplicity but confine the possibility space to choices and response forms already present in AraLearn.
It would create contracts, runtimes and maintenance obligations before product requirements and demonstrated course needs exist.
H5P, Moodle, Open edX and similar systems remain useful precedents or future integrations, but their assumptions do not match the complete ARA mission and mobile/offline authoring constraints.

justification: AraLearn provides operational evidence for mobile, offline, structured and repairable study, but its response model and governance are narrower than the intended research platform.
Literature distinguishes retrieval, spacing, response format, feedback, stakes and learner control rather than supporting a single universal study configuration.
Cross-domain systems demonstrate legitimate domain grammars and instruments, but no one component model is justified as the ARA baseline.
Closed and localized contracts support MCP generation and repair, while broad functionality can be achieved through composition and governed capabilities.
Personal, research, teaching and institutional profiles require different policies while preserving shared course and configuration semantics.

notRecommended: renderer geometry as default canonical course data
LLM open-response scoring presented as deterministic truth
universal capability implementation before demonstrated need
automatic promotion of experimental 0.2 contracts to product domain

decisionChangingUncertainties: stakeholder testing may require stronger profile mediation for the long configuration form
MCP generation and localized repair tests may require smaller operations or schema segmentation
Galaxy A07 benchmarks may force package or profile separation
CETESB, IFSP or University of Lisbon requirements may change identity, data, consent or integration boundaries
a dissertation or representative course may make one advanced capability a first-scope priority
accessibility evaluation may exclude or redesign specific constructive interactions

handoffToIssue4.recommendation: Begin the first taxonomy round using both the AraLearn reference map and the external opportunity map. Preserve discovered and deferred states; only accepted parameters become normative inputs to #6.
handoffToIssue4.reason: No unresolved strategic or value conflict changes the recommended layered route in this round.
